BUILT FOR
GORILLA TAG

01
One-Click MelonLoader
Install and manage MelonLoader with a single click. Booster detects your version automatically — no manual setup needed.
02
Daily Auto-Refresh
The Mod Hub fetches 30+ mods from GitHub every 24 hours automatically — always showing the latest community releases.
03
MelInEx Bridge
Run BepInEx plugins inside MelonLoader using the built-in MelInEx bridge toggle — no dual installs required.
04
Smart Filtering
Filter Mod Hub by All, MelonLoader, or BepInEx. Search by name, description, or type — find exactly what you need instantly.
05
Offline Cache
Mods are cached locally at %APPDATA%\BoosterModManager — fully functional even without internet.
06
Zero Telemetry
No tracking, no analytics, no personal data collected. HTTP calls go only to api.github.com for mod discovery.
// Mod Hub

30+ MODS,
AUTO-DISCOVERED

The built-in Mod Hub searches GitHub daily for the latest Gorilla Tag mods, automatically detects whether each one is a MelonLoader or BepInEx mod, and links directly to the latest release DLL.

MelonLoader
v0.6.x
MelonLoader Mods
The primary mod framework for Gorilla Tag. Booster installs MelonLoader directly and manages .dll mods in the Mods/ folder. Supports cosmetics, maps, movement mods, and utilities.
Install path[GT Root]\Mods\
Cosmetics Maps Movement Utilities Multiplayer
BepInEx
via MelInEx
BepInEx Plugins
BepInEx plugins work via the built-in MelInEx bridge — toggle it on in the MelonLoader tab and BepInEx .dll plugins drop into BepInEx/plugins/ and run seamlessly alongside MelonLoader mods.

// Getting started

UP & RUNNING
IN MINUTES

1

Download the ZIP

Hit Download Free above and save Booster-Mod-Manager_v1_1.zip somewhere permanent on your PC.

2

Extract the Archive

Right-click the ZIP → Extract All. Choose a fixed folder — never run the app from inside the ZIP itself.

3

Launch Booster

Open the extracted folder and run BoosterModManager.exe. If Windows SmartScreen appears, click More info → Run anyway.

4

Point, Pick & Play

Select your Gorilla Tag install directory, browse the mod list, hit Install — then launch the game and swing!
